name: merge_pull_request
description: Merge a pull request of a repository you work on (one in your workspace, or one the person named). `method` is `squash` (the default), `merge` or `rebase`; with `delete_branch: true` the pull request's branch is deleted afterwards, when it is a branch of that very repository. GitHub's own rules decide whether it merges (branch protection, required checks and reviews, conflicts): if it refuses you get its words, and you tell the person; do not look for another way. It needs the auto access tier or above.

repo.description: The repository: its slot's name in your workspace, `owner/name`, or its address

delete_branch.description: Delete the pull request's branch after the merge (only a branch of that repository)
